english_definition: A high-quality class of travelling (especially in airlines), higher than economy class or budget, lower than first class.
a flight made without intermediate stops between source and destination
A part of an airport, in a departure lounge, behind which passengers wait to board an aircraft
A document or card, similar to a ticket, needed in order to board an airplane or other mode of transport.
a flight with an intermediate stop and a change of aircraft (possibly a change of airlines)
A trip where a knowledgeable guide leads a group to a destination, providing commentary and historical context while often handling logistics like accommodation and transportation.
A company that arranges travel and accommodation for travellers.
A physical condition caused by crossing time zones during flight; often the result of disruption to the circadian rhythms of the body.
